notes: Light-only: a full Radix light+dark scale is loaded but `html` is locked to `.light` and craft.theme.supportsDark is false, so `color.dark` is omitted rather than invented. Accents are authored as display-p3 with sRGB fallbacks; the hex values above are the fallbacks. `type.scale` is three disconnected clusters, not a ratio ramp — 0.875/1rem is chrome, 4.6875/5.3125rem is statement type, and 45rem (720px) is the sheet height used verbatim as `font-size` on the clipped display glyphs (container-derived, not a scale step); do not treat it as a reusable size. `leading` is inferred from the clipped headline line boxes, not from declared `line-height`. `space.scale` is the site's declared `--space-1…11` ramp; the page itself uses only 8/9/40/50/64px — 9px (minimap tick gap) and 50px (sheet padding) are off the 8px grid and were kept as-is rather than rounded, and the 40px rail gutter is derived from the 1240px stride on 1200px sheets (the declared `gap: 8px` never applies, since the sheets are absolutely positioned). `shadow` is empty and that is real: the raw profile records zero box-shadows and zero gradients on this page (shadow tokens are declared but unused). The `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` easing is a declared token, unused on the index. Scroll `transform` values are written per-frame from rAF, so they have no duration — the two durations listed cover only the tracker transition and the sheet entrance.
